question: Who among the following has been selected for the Padma Vibhushan Award under the category 'Art-Acting-Theatre' for the year 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Balwant Moreshwar Purandare**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Balwant Moreshwar Purandare, also known as Babasaheb Purandare, was awarded the Padma Vibhushan in 2019 for his contributions in the field of art-acting-theatre.
 
• He is known for his books such as Raja Shiv Chhatrapati, Purandaryanchi Daulat, Purandaryanchi Naubat, and Gadsanch. 
 
• The Padma Vibhushan is the second-highest civilian award in India.
 
• It is awarded to people who have made distinguished service to the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Atul Punj:
 
 
• Atul Punj is a well-known Indian businessman and entrepreneur, primarily associated with the construction and engineering sector.
 
• He is the founder and former Chairman and Managing Director of Punj Lloyd Group, a multinational conglomerate involved in various sectors like infrastructure, energy, and defense.
 
 
 
• Anil Kumar Manibhai Naik:
 
 
• Anil Naik is the Chairman of Larsen & Toubro (L&T), one of India's largest engineering and construction conglomerates.
 
• He has played a significant role in India's infrastructure development, leading L&T to execute numerous large-scale projects across the country and internationally.
 
 
 
• Grandhi Mallikarjuna Rao:
 
 
• Grandhi Mallikarjuna Rao is a prominent Indian politician and former Union Minister.
 
• He is associated with the Indian National Congress party and has held various important positions in the government of Andhra Pradesh.
